alignment_tolerance_correction.defect: the whole-track alignment tolerance was a flat 0.15s, the same constant used per beat. Video quantizes each beat up to a frame boundary and narration does not, so the assembled track accumulates one frame of drift per beat: 7 beats at 30fps drifts up to 0.233s and the check failed on correct arithmetic.
alignment_tolerance_correction.surfaced_by: full-suite ordering — the suite regenerated narration at a slightly different length and the flat tolerance broke, while the isolated run happened to sit under it
alignment_tolerance_correction.fix: tolerance is now derived as beatCount/fps + 0.05s epsilon, recorded in the manifest with its basis; the per-beat 0.15s check is unchanged
alignment_tolerance_correction.still_discriminating: an assembly fault (dropped or duplicated segment) is whole seconds, far outside the derived allowance
